This section is available in the Premier and Advantage editions.

flash
Specify how Flash plugins are treated. Value is one of
allow-all  or block-all  (default).

java
Specify how Java plugins are treated. Value is one of:
java_max_ood_days
The number of days that Java plugins may be out of date
before access is blocked ( java  must be warn-and-
block  for the plugin to be blocked). Value is one of 0 ,
3 , 7 , 14 , 30  (default), 60 , 90 , 180 , or 365 . Other
values are invalid.
